annotations.title: Read a university prerequisite short course

description: Read a recognised prerequisite short course by its ID and optionally filter related degrees to an intake year. Includes institution, study hours, access and completion periods, separate short-course fee with verified region and date where available, official links, and each linked degree’s applicant group, recognised requirement and deadline. Completing a short course satisfies only the stated prerequisite. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

feeRegion.description: Optional two-letter country code, e.g. AU. If omitted, verified regional quotes retain their quoted region. A quote for another requested region is replaced by an official pricing link.
